VBO:0200448.summary: Rural property guarding and defence guide the Dogo Sardesco’s Sardinian breeding project. Local fanciers select typical dogs and follow puppies placed with trusted island keepers for possible future breeding. Preserving working aptitudes through rural life and careful selection is a guiding aim of the programme.
VBO:0200448.shortDescription: A Sardinian working dog whose fanciers’ project focuses on rural property guarding and preserving working aptitudes.
